newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan voluntary jobless number increasing--govt.
newsitem.headline: Japan voluntary jobless number increasing--govt.

text.p: The improving economy caused an increase in the number of people leaving their jobs voluntarily in September, a senior official of the government's Management and Coordination Agency told reporters on Tuesday.
The official said the number of people who left their jobs voluntarily in September totalled 930,000, up 30,000 from a year earlier.
The agency said the overall jobless rate in September was 3.3 percent, unchanged from August. In July it had fallen to 3.4 percent from a historic high of 3.5 percent recorded both in May and June.
"We have to wait until the end of 1996 to determine whether we passed the peak of unemployment in June of this year," the official said.
The official said the number of people who left their jobs voluntarily in Sepbember was the highest since January 1983, when the agency started collecting the jobless data.
"Overall, we see an improving economy as a possible cause of the rise in people leaving their jobs voluntarily," he said.
